name: 삼환
outfit: 하늘색 빛이 도는 흰색 흉갑과 짧은 망토
accessories: 등 뒤에 달린 작은 기계식 탄창 보관함
weapon: 화살 대신 빛의 탄환을 발사하는 짧은 기계식 석궁
silhouette: 짧고 둥근 체형, 등 뒤의 작은 튀어나온 탄창, 앞으로 뻗은 짧은 석궁, 펄럭이는 아주 작은 망토
signature_motion: 석궁을 어깨에 고정하고 몸을 앞뒤로 아주 미세하게 반동시키는 자세
signature_vfx: 석궁 끝에서 발사되는 눈부신 하늘색 빛의 탄환 궤적
visual_en: A 2-head tall mechanical creature facing right. The head features a single glowing sky-blue eye behind a bronze metal mask and short silver metallic hair. The body is made of polished bronze metal with a small white chestplate accented by sky-blue trim. A tiny, stiff white cape flutters behind. On its back, a small mechanical ammunition box is attached with thin tubes connected to the arm. The creature holds a short, compact mechanical crossbow. The left hand shows distinct mechanical finger joints. The overall silhouette is compact and bright, featuring a prominent sky-blue glow that stands out against dark backgrounds.
pose_en: Standing in a focused, low-profile sniping stance.
vfx_en: A bright, rapid streak of sky-blue light shot from the crossbow.
motion_en: Quick, rhythmic recoil motion of the crossbow.
lore: 빠른 원거리 사수. 도르반과 같은 방식으로 쏜다.
